{{Quote|I'm not sure this is a good idea, but it's the only way.|Mara Jade, as she prepares to sneak aboard the pirate's Nebulon-B frigate|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Lumini pirates']] '''Nebulon-B frigate''' participated in raids to pillage supplies from other [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] worked alongside the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates']] [[Lumini pirates' Interdictor cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]]. While the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Interdictor]] used its [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] to hold victims, the Nebulon-B docked and sent boarders to collect stolen goods. Then, the pirate strike force would depart, with the Nebulon-B's three [[Engine/Legends|engines]] as the targets watched them enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="MOTS" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the Lumini pirates, deployed their Nebulon-B in a [[Seizure of the Jedi holocron|raid]] on a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]]. Their Interdictor's gravity wells rendered the corvette's hyperdrive useless, so the frigate's raiding party boarded the ship and began moving supplies through its docking port. Unbeknownst to the pirates, a secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]] was onboard and guarded by Jedi [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Jade stowed aboard the frigate in the last cargo container before the frigate and other pirate ships jumped to their [[Orbiting Ship Yards]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MOTSNebulonB.png|thumb|right|150px|The Nebulon-B frigate from the game manual]]
{{Quote|Mara's next mission took place aboard a New Republic Corellian corvette. The designer Steve Hwang actually took a schematic and laid the mission out EXACTLY conforming to shape and space of the corvette. There's no faking on this one.|Level developer Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The Lumini pirates' Nebulon-B frigate appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> Designer [[Stephen Hwang]] laid out the game level where the Nebulon-B appeared onscreen.<ref name="Blog" />
